subject: Application some times disconnects from the server in Opera40 and Chrome58

messages.author: 862dcfdada8cc0b2
messages.subject: Application some times disconnects from the server in Opera40 and Chrome58
parts:
I have shiny application deployed on private server. I tried its functionality with different browsers and sometimes found its malfunctioning in the following cases

1) In Linux 16.04 I used it with different web browsers and found that download is not working sometimes with Opera40 and Chrome58, downloading an .html content other than .zip files. When the download is not working the application also gets disconnected from the server. I have also .pdf files for that there is no problem in downloading.

2) In windows 10, I saw the same behavior with Opera40, Google Chrome58, and Microsoft Edge sometimes. Again during malfunctioning the application gets disconnected from the server.

3) In Microsoft Edge, textbox are not working well.

What can be the reason for all this. Thank you.
